evals.name: map-validation-errors
evals.prompt: Validate a CreateUserRequest struct with go-playground/validator/v10 and map errors to API field violations.
evals.expected_output: Validation execution and conversion of validator.ValidationErrors to structured API error response.
assertions: Maps each field error to a clean client message (e.g. 'Email is required').

evals.name: custom-validator-rule
evals.prompt: Register a custom validation tag 'iso4217' with validator/v10 to validate 3-letter currency codes.
evals.expected_output: Registration of custom validation function using validate.RegisterValidation.
assertions: Registers custom validation function using RegisterValidation('iso4217', ...).
Applies tag on struct field (e.g. Currency string `validate:'required,iso4217'`).
Unit tests both valid currency codes (USD, EUR) and invalid strings.

evals.name: singleton-validator-lifecycle
evals.prompt: How should validator.Validate instances be managed across HTTP requests in a high-traffic service?
evals.expected_output: Instantiate validator once as a singleton/dependency and reuse it concurrently across all requests.
assertions: Reuses a single *validator.Validate instance across all requests.
Avoids re-instantiating validator inside request handlers.
Explains that validator caches struct tag analysis and is thread-safe for concurrent use.
